about: Where every tree stands as the web build plants it (the planting rule told each tree’s footprint by its model): species, variant, position, scale, facing, radius as an obstacle and for the walk grid, and the model it is drawn with where that is fixed; and the places the rule offers without measuring any tree model, for a port that brings its own trees.
units: metres, seconds, radians; x east, z south, y up
